executive_verdict.adoption_decision: Transport/UI architecture can inform a separately tested implementation. Do not replace SocialBox admission proof with reference VPN status, copy broad exclusions, or claim no-MDM isolation from this static extraction. NET-040 remains GAP.
executive_verdict.architecture: Personal/on-demand IPv4 packet tunnel with explicit excluded routes, localhost HTTP(S) bridge, lwIP TCP/SOCKS path and shared global proxy selection. Helpers and secretsauced support lifecycle/control-plane work.
not_demonstrated: Kernel-enforced deny-all that survives provider/controller death
Per-app or selected-container attribution of raw packet/broker traffic
Verified socket drain before reconfigure restart
Recovered transactional whole-container switch and rollback ordering
statically_demonstrated: IPv4 default routing plus explicit exclusions
Local proxy and upstream TCP/SOCKS processing
Captured UDP filtering and synthetic DNS/ICMP behavior
Queued proxy reconfiguration and availability recovery

limitations: Reconstructed pseudocode may misinfer locals, return types, callbacks and branch conditions.
Obfuscated runtime strings were not decoded; negative text searches only bound the inspected representation.
Some authentication/licensing-named methods were intentionally omitted by the extractor; no conclusion relies on removing them.
FUN_100236804 (global switch worker) remains unresolved; representative assembly calls do not reconstruct the full transaction.
No packets, runtime bindings, death/reboot behavior or retained connection state were measured in this task.
Existing read-only PF/device observations are separate historical evidence and not a validation of this reference transport.

mechanical_search.interpretation: Zero matches is not proof of runtime absence.

required_before_adoption: Recover or replace central switch ordering with explicit durable operation ownership, stale-callback fencing and interruption recovery.
Define honest assurance scope: one active container with device-wide transport is not independent per-app attribution. Address shared UID, brokers, loopback and unsolicited inactive app traffic.
Replace fixed stop delay with explicit flow cancellation/drain acknowledgement and prove process plus socket quiescence.
Specify fail-closed enforcement independent of controller/provider death, with tested finite revocation and safe USB/out-of-band recovery.
Eliminate or tightly justify every direct route/DNS exception; do not copy 17/8 or LAN blanket bypasses as isolation defaults.
Measure IPv4/IPv6, DNS/DoH, UDP/QUIC, ICMP, interface changes, proxy outage, provider death, daemon death, retained sockets and reboot using physical captures.
Review privileged caller identity checks and broad process-name termination independently before reusing helper APIs.
Preserve licenses, cloud ownership, original application data and current fail-closed SocialBox gating while evaluating transport alternatives.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Shared configuration is not a container/generation-bound authorization receipt. Atomic plist writes alone do not establish transaction-wide consistency across both stores.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Keep SocialBox authoritative profile/proxy binding, operation ownership and generation revalidation; do not substitute global defaults for a scoped lease.
rows.static_observation: The host writes proxy host, port, type, credentials, exclusions and rotation URL into shared defaults and vpn_config.plist. The extension reads suite defaults and falls back to the shared group configuration file. No credential values are reproduced here.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: On-demand activation is not an independent kill switch, an all-networks rule, a per-app identity check or proof that flows remain blocked while the provider restarts.
rows.socialbox_comparison: This could support a separately labelled no-MDM transport experiment. Current SocialBox app-proxy MDM receipt cannot be satisfied by this personal tunnel.
rows.static_observation: The host creates NETunnelProviderProtocol, sets provider bundle/server/configuration, enables the manager and installs NEOnDemandRuleConnect with interface match 0. The save/load/start chain is present.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Route configuration does not prove every app flow enters this provider, and exclusions in the next row intentionally remove destinations.
rows.socialbox_comparison: A no-MDM backend needs a distinct device-wide assurance scope and physical routing evidence; NET-040 remains a gap.
rows.static_observation: Provider startup sets 198.18.0.1/24 and an NEIPv4Route defaultRoute before submitting NEPacketTunnelNetworkSettings.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: This cannot be described as proxy-only for all destinations. In particular broad Apple/LAN exclusions are not restricted to a single control-plane process or socket. Actual route precedence and egress still require device measurement.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Do not copy these exclusions into SocialBox fail-closed policy. USB recovery, DNS and control traffic require precise separately reviewed exceptions.
rows.static_observation: Startup explicitly excludes 192.168/16, 10/8, 172.16/12, 127/8, the proxy IPv4 /32, 17/8, 224/4 and 169.254/16; configured values are appended as /32 exclusions.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: A branch capable of reading an IPv6 TCP packet does not prove an IPv6 default route, extension-header handling, all IPv6 transport interception, or direct IPv6 blocking.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Retain NET-040 IPv4/IPv6 acceptance as NOT_RUN. A device-wide adapter must explicitly define and measure both families.
rows.static_observation: The inspected startup constructs IPv4 and DNS/proxy settings; its body contains no IPv6 settings assignment. classifyPacket has a non-AF_INET branch that only admits a fixed-header next-protocol TCP value into lwIP.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Do not infer all DNS is sent through the proxy merely from the presence of the DNS mapper. Successful bridge operation does not follow the same synthetic-DNS setup branch.
rows.socialbox_comparison: SocialBox must separately measure resolver, background and encrypted-DNS behavior; its current app-proxy DNS responder is a different mechanism.
rows.static_observation: When no local listener or no listener port exists, startup assigns the synthetic DNS server 198.18.0.2 and match domains. When a live local listener exists it instead adds HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings; the DNS assignment is conditional.
rows.surface: DNS interception varies with bridge availability

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Bypassed domains are resolved by the system path, whose egress is not proven proxy-confined here. Exact runtime bypass list and suffix delimiter need retained data/disassembly validation before reuse; no hidden constants were decoded.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Keep control-plane attribution separate from clone DNS; do not claim NXDOMAIN-only policy matches this mapper.
rows.static_observation: The DNS mapper returns synthetic IPv4 addresses for ordinary A questions, empty answer data for other ordinary types, and uses getaddrinfo(AF_INET) on its bypass branch. Bypass matching lowercases names and checks equality or suffix.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Dropping a captured QUIC packet is not proof no QUIC takes excluded routes. Local ICMP success is not an internet reachability or proxy-health measurement.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Acceptance must distinguish synthetic replies, denied captured traffic and independently observed physical egress.
rows.static_observation: IPv4 classifier only sends TCP to lwIP, UDP destination port 53 to DNS processing and protocol 1 to local ICMP processing; other captured UDP/protocols return. ICMP echo requests are answered by swapping IP addresses and writing a locally synthesized reply.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: The adapter receives packets without an app identity field in these call paths. Sessions dictionary membership is not per-container attribution or a finite lease.
rows.socialbox_comparison: SocialBox current NEAppProxyFlow sourceAppSigningIdentifier and exact bundle checks cannot be inferred from raw packetFlow.
rows.static_observation: readPackets callbacks classify frames. handleTcpAccept resolves fake destination addresses back to hostnames, creates a DLWTcpSession, registers the PCB in sessions and starts the SOCKS client path.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: No client identity or per-container authorization is demonstrated by the listener accept path. Loopback reachability does not identify the selected container.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Treat localhost proxy as shared broker traffic; NET-040 cannot claim selected-container-only access simply from the bridge.
rows.static_observation: DLWLocalConnectListener binds an AF_INET stream listener to 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port, listens and dispatches accepted clients to a worker. Startup installs that local listener as the system HTTP and HTTPS proxy.

evidence.note: Large recovered function has uncertain inferred locals; restrict this observation to explicit calls and close/error branches.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Socket option numeric values and obfuscated branch behavior need deeper ABI/disassembly review before assigning special bypass claims. Proxy handshake success alone is not a measured exit-IP or immutable route receipt.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Reuse protocol ideas only behind exact proxy endpoint policy, bounded cancellation and evidence binding; retain no-direct-fallback tests.
rows.static_observation: The bridge worker creates upstream connections using FUN_100133a00; that helper opens AF_INET TCP sockets, applies socket options and connects to a literal or a system-resolved host. Bridge error paths emit HTTP 502 and close handles. DLWSocks5Client separately creates a proxy TCP connection and performs SOCKS negotiation.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: This is normal provider teardown. It does not demonstrate post-crash kernel blocking, old external socket/state purge, or that the host waits for this completion before starting a replacement.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Retain explicit CLOSE acknowledgement, registered process death and socket drain in the SocialBox transaction.
rows.static_observation: stopTunnel cancels both timers, stops the local listener, closes each tracked lwIP session, clears the session dictionary, shuts down the net stack, invokes completion and calls _exit(0). DLWTcpSession.close marks closed and cancels its read source or closes a proxy descriptor.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: No container UUID, boot epoch, generation, expiry, source-app binding or verified CLOSED/ARMED/OPEN receipt is returned by this method.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Never convert these stats to SocialBox systemFirewall enforced=true; preserve the existing provider identity and fresh scoped receipt requirements.
rows.static_observation: handleAppMessage only recognizes a stats request and returns tx/rx packet/byte counters, tracked sessions and running=true; other messages reply nil.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Serializing parameter updates does not prove no packet escapes during stop/restart. In-flight sockets and app launch remain separate concerns.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Useful UI/control-plane pattern; preserve SocialBox operation token, stale callback fencing and exact lease generations.
rows.static_observation: Host reconfigure builds a fingerprint, deduplicates an equivalent connection, retains latest pending parameters and completion callbacks under objc_sync, and drains the pending configuration queue. Apply reconfigure short-circuits unchanged configuration or uses stopWithCompletion then startWithHost.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: A 500 ms timer cannot establish that the old provider and every upstream socket have stopped. Reconfiguration callback starts a new tunnel; this timing assumption must not serve as isolation proof.
rows.socialbox_comparison: SocialBox killAndWait/CLOSED receipt/socket drain ordering is stricter in code and must survive any backend adoption.
rows.static_observation: FUN_10024c728 disables on-demand, initiates save/stop callbacks, and independently schedules caller completion after 500,000,000 ns. FUN_10024c980 calls selector stopTunnel; FUN_10024c9cc invokes the retained completion without a status/readback predicate in that callback.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: A per-container proxy association in metadata can select a global transport, but does not create multiple concurrent app-attributed enforcement domains.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Adopt one-active-container semantics explicitly if pursued; do not advertise independent simultaneous proxy isolation from this global manager.
rows.static_observation: AppDelegate reloads the proxy store, reads ActiveProxyUUID, chooses a record, updates active selection/status and calls the shared VPN manager reconfigure with host, port, protocol and credentials.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: A selector in the API inventory is not implemented behavior. Actual global switching is elsewhere and must be traced separately.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Do not replace the tested SocialBox transaction with this endpoint or count it as implementation coverage.
rows.static_observation: Helper switchToContainer:forBundleID:reply: constructs NSError code 0x1f5 (501) with the visible Notimplemented_Phase2 description and replies with failure; it performs no container or network transition.
rows.surface: Helper container switch endpoint is a stub

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Name-based killall and its exit status do not prove exact registered process paths, descendants/brokers or zero residual sockets. The decompiler infers a void helper even though the caller uses a result; retain that uncertainty.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Keep SocialBox exact registered bundle paths, explicit service exclusions, cancellation fencing and independent process/socket verification (including the earlier C04 regression).
rows.static_observation: killApp dispatches to a worker that scans installed bundle Info.plist for matching CFBundleIdentifier and derives CFBundleExecutable; it uses killall -9 and falls back to transformed bundle-name components. A helper waits for the killall subprocess exit.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: CLI/helper request success alone cannot replace process or socket-table verification; endpoint identity and concurrency need a separate review.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Expose a constrained operation-owned CLI if needed; do not adopt an unchecked kill result as CLOSED proof.
rows.static_observation: CLI killAppViaSocket creates an AF_UNIX stream, connects to its helper endpoint and exchanges a request, with fallback into the CLI kill path. killApp includes a posix_spawn path deriving a process name.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: The shown branch admits generic installed-app paths for mobile/root; exact code-signature/team/bundle allowlisting is not demonstrated here. Audit-token presence in imports is not sufficient. Do not expose privileged mutation methods by copying this admission policy.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Preserve SocialBox own authenticated/scoped IPC and root-owned private state; review caller admission independently of the tunnel.
rows.static_observation: The listener obtains a process identifier/path, accepts a path substring match or an installed-app path containing .app/, and then admits effective UID 0 or 501 before exporting an XPC object.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: These methods concern the daemon transport. No kernel packet policy or selected-clone lease revocation is demonstrated by these methods; do not relabel server keepalive as an independent firewall revoker.
rows.socialbox_comparison: SocialBox lease heartbeat expiry is separately consumed in its provider; NET-040 still requires independent revocation after controller death.
rows.static_observation: secretsauced disconnect stops pending keepalive, invalidates/cancels its connection with daemon_intentional, and transitions connection phase. prepareForAirplaneDisconnect schedules follow-up work after 200 ms.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Detecting network/VPN changes and reconnecting a cloud socket is not evidence of a packet-level deny policy while connectivity is unavailable or changing.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Retain network-change, tunnel-death and stale-lease acceptance tests rather than treating path satisfied as permission to OPEN.
rows.static_observation: setupNetworkMonitor starts nw_path_monitor on the main queue. Its callback observes path status/interface type and calls connect on recovery branches; reconnectDelayForError returns bounded retry delays.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: No reliable complete CLOSE → kill → socket drain → rotate → arm → open ordering can be asserted for the whole worker from this extraction. Presence of one call is not a verified transaction or rollback design.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Retain SocialBox ordering invariant and interruption journal. Do not replace it wholesale based on UI behavior or this unresolved worker.
rows.static_observation: switchToGlobalContainer asynchronously dispatches FUN_100236804. The extraction marks that worker unresolved_with_instruction_listing. Its retained ARM64 listing contains a call to the killApp:reply: selector at instruction 0x100237160, so termination is attempted somewhere in the worker.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Obfuscated strings, dynamic selectors, omitted methods and external OS/provider policy mean a negative text search is not proof no such mechanism exists. No kernel policy installation or per-app enforcement proof was recovered in the inspected paths.
rows.socialbox_comparison: NET-040 remains GAP. Existing actual PF read-only observations and unlinked policy model do not become deployment evidence through reference-product adoption.
rows.static_observation: A case-sensitive mechanical search of the five inspected component pseudocode files for NEIPv6, includeAllNetworks, enforceRoutes, NEAppRule, appRules, routingMethod, DIOC, /dev/pf and pfctl found no match. On-demand selectors were found separately and traced above.

rows.not_proven_or_risk: Availability recovery is not default-deny behavior. Removing/stopping a personal tunnel can restore ordinary routing; actual physical egress during both recovery tiers remains untested.
rows.socialbox_comparison: Keep safe closure and explicit operator recovery separate from UI availability. Never mark protected because a stuck tunnel was removed.
rows.static_observation: Host watchdog starts for connecting/disconnecting states, Tier1 requests stop/changes on-demand preferences and schedules another timer, and Tier2 can remove the VPN manager configuration from preferences.

scope.method: Inspected Ghidra pseudocode and function/selector indexes; exact decoded instructions used only for one unresolved-worker call. No original source was supplied.
scope.secrets: No credential, token or hidden decoded constant values included. Symbol names and configuration key names only.

socialbox_reference_contract.summary: CLOSE, global kill/wait, CLOSED provider acknowledgement, license/profile/managed-install validation, rotation, socket drain, freeze, ARM acknowledgement, launch/hook readiness and isolation refresh before OPEN.
Provider identity requires transport app-proxy, not just a running tunnel.
ARM-to-OPEN generation and scoped acknowledgement checks, failure closes lease.
Finite heartbeat/expiry, per-app scope, managed bundle membership and exact source/proxy checks.
Actual NEAppProxyProvider; closes all tracked flows before policy change acknowledgement; stale async completion cannot revive old lease.
Managed per-app assignment requirement; does not install a personal/global VPN fallback.
Non-shipping model only; no kernel adapter or independent revoker implementation.
NET-040 remains a gap; no-MDM measured enforcement absent.
